_about: Documented corrections to the OGL First1KGreek transcription of Swete where verse numbering (not text) is defective and would break TVTMS tests. Automatic OCR repairs (a number that sits between n-1 and n+1, e.g. '220' between 19 and 21) are applied by the loader and logged in build/alignment_report.json; the entries here are the ones the automatic rule cannot decide.

Ps 91.note: Swete 91:15 contains both 15 and 16 (merged in the transcription); without this the psalm would be read as the 'title merged' tradition and shift by one verse.

Wis._note: The transcription labels Wisdom 15-19 as chapters 16-20 (no chapter 15); verified by incipit 'Σὺ δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν χρηστὸς' = Wis 15:1.
